channelTitle: Wet socks to fight a fever? Sounds backwards, but hear Grandma June out
hook: Putting on damp, cold socks when you're already running warm sounds like the last thing you'd want to do, so why did grandmothers swear by it?
remedy: Wearing damp cotton socks covered by warm wool socks overnight, an old naturopathic-style home remedy, was believed to draw circulation to the feet and help the body feel more comfortable during a mild fever.
steps: Soak a pair of thin cotton socks in cool water and wring them out well
Put the damp socks on, then cover with a thicker pair of dry wool socks
Rest in bed and let your feet warm the socks up overnight
caution: This is a comfort measure, not a fever treatment - see a doctor for a high fever, a fever in a young child, or one that doesn't come down.
cta: Has anyone in your family actually tried the wet sock trick? Tell Grandma June if it's new to you.
